title: Phone Slip: Cascade Press Wire Write-Through, 16:50

fields.message: Moving a write-through on OR-MISSING-CHILD at 17:00. Lede: "The alert came more than two hours after the first 911 call." Wants ON THE RECORD: why the delay? Is the man named in the viral post a suspect? (They've seen the @AFTruthTeller post naming him, 640 shares.) ALSO: APD PIO emailed 16:52, OSP + FD1 cc'd, wants ONE joint text for the 17:00 briefing. Theirs still says 13:50 + dark blue.

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Before 17:00 the PIO should put out one JIC statement that INV has cleared and the Undersheriff has approved. It should correct the grandparent's truck description and say no one has been named. It should also give the next update time and go to APD, OSP and FD1 with the same numbers. Watch for three more things: the PIO reports the naming post to the platform, sets the terms of attribution before answering the wire desk, and explains the delay from the decision record without offering any theory.
